selection_rule: No parameter selection: all policies are user-predeclared; Policy C included as the single low-cost controlled variant.

timeout_semantics.qualification_path: completed 1-second bars with ts_event strictly before timeout
timeout_semantics.timeout_exit: first available 1-second open strictly after timeout
timeout_semantics.timeout_bar_stop: existing stop remains active until market fill

policy_b_semantics.activation: at timeout decision for the timeout bar range or first available later bar
policy_b_semantics.gap_fill: bar open when open is through protected level; otherwise protected level
policy_b_semantics.persistence: remains active after a later aligning flip
policy_b_semantics.same_bar_rule: stop is loss-first versus favorable excursion

post_alignment_semantics.policy_b_qualified_stop: persistent entry plus direction times 0.75 ATR
post_alignment_semantics.fallback_exit: stored next opposing regime flip open
